title: Isimemezelo Sokucwila
intro: Cabanga ngombusi onamandla ozungezwe ubukhazikhazi, izikhumbuzo, namabutho alalela umyalo owodwa. Lesi sibalo sathi sinegunya eliphakeme, salahla izibonakaliso zaphezulu njengeziyinkohliso, futhi sayala ukuba kulandelwe olwandle ngokungapheli. Landela umkhondo kusukela ezinqumweni zokuzikhukhumeza kuya emanzini ahlukene, lapho ukuvuma kokugcina kufika sekwephuzile kakhulu ukuba kusindiswe.
clues: Nganginamandla aphelele futhi ngabagqilaza abantwana bakwa-Israyeli ngaphansi kokubusa kwami.
Ngazibiza ngokuthi ngiyiNkosi ephakeme kakhulu futhi ngenqaba ukuvuma noma yimuphi unkulunkulu ongaphezu kwami.
Ngayala uHamani ukuba angakhele umbhoshongo ophakeme ukuze ngibheke uNkulunkulu kaMose.
Ngabhekana noMusa noHarun lapho beletha izimpawu ezicacile, futhi ngabiza izimangaliso zabo ngokuthi ubuthakathi.
Ngamlandela uMose namakholwa kanye namabutho ami ebusuku saze safika olwandle.
Ngamemezela ukholo ngesikhathi ngiminza olwandle, kodwa kwase kwephuze kakhulu, futhi isidumbu sami sagcinwa njengesibonakaliso.
